title: Pairing as a QR code: nerv open --phone --qr and Settings → Pair a device
goal: Scanning a QR pairs a browser in one step; the code is generated locally
acceptance: A vendored, pinned, dependency-free MIT QR encoder (named to the owner before adding)
nerv open --phone --qr prints a terminal QR plus the short code; Settings shows the same
The iOS limit (a scan opens Safari, not the installed app) is stated in the procedure

Since the review of #707 (F-118-T02) a browser tab refuses a pairing code and only the installed app pairs; a scan opens Safari, so a QR cannot pair the installed app in one step. Before building, the owner decides what a scanned QR does (for example carry the code to type in the installed app, or sign the tab in with a session-length credential, not a 90-day device)
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
